title: Nightly 3 a.m. wake-ups and communing
summary: Whitley Strieber tells of Nightly 3 a.m. wake-ups and communing, about 2015-2020 at Strieber's home, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: for the first five years from 19 2015 until 2020, they woke me up religiously every night.

plain: Whitley Strieber is a writer who says he has been in contact with non-human beings for many years. On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, he says that from 2015 to 2020 these beings woke him at his home every single night around 3 a.m., and that he spent that time in contact with them. He writes about this in his book The Hidden Garden, and tells it as proof that the contact is ongoing and personal.
